name: Everyday Etiquette
summary: A library keeper seeks magical works to add to the collection. Your contribution helps expand the library’s knowledge.

sections.title: A Growing Collection
sections.body: The keeper of the Library in Ironforge asks you to bring magical works that might benefit the collection. Your efforts help the library’s knowledge grow.

faq.q: What does the library keeper want?
faq.answer: The keeper seeks magical works that might benefit the library.
The request concerns the Library in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why are magical works being collected?
faq.answer: The keeper says each contribution expands the library’s knowledge.
